abstract: The invention discloses a composite identification method for kinetic parameters of an industrial robot. The method comprises the following steps: establishing an industrial robot kinetic model and carrying out linearization processing; a five-order Fourier series is adopted as an excitation track of the industrial robot; controlling the industrial robot to move according to the designed excitation track, and sampling joint torque and joint angle information to obtain observation torque and an observation matrix; based on the industrial robot kinetic equation and the observation data, kinetic parameters of the industrial robot are obtained through identification by using a least square method; and compensating the friction torque through the BP neural network. According to the method, the excitation trajectory is designed into the five-order Fourier series, so that the influence of interference factors such as noise on the observation data set is effectively reduced, and the precision of the observation data set is greatly improved; the friction torque is compensated through the friction model obtained by training the BP neural network, so that the deviation of the predicted friction torque is effectively reduced, and the identification accuracy of the dynamic parameters of the industrial robot is improved.
source_title: Industrial robot kinetic parameter composite identification method

abstract: To provide an industrial robot, correcting hanging-down of the tip of a fork to easily, quickly and precisely convey a conveyed material without any increase in thickness even if the fork is long. The fork 16 is removably fitted to a hand 15 by a bolt 17. The hand 15 is provided with a fork tip position adjusting means 20 composed of a shim 21 and a shim presser 22 which are abutted on the lower surface of the fork 16 to push up the tip side of the fork 16. The shims 21 of various thicknesses are previously provided, and the shim having such a thickness that the tip of the fork 16 is substantially equal to the base end is selected and used.
source_title: INDUSTRIAL ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses a composite fixture used for an industrial robot. The composite fixture used for the industrial robot comprises an arm, wherein clamping buckles are respectively fixedly connected with the left side and the right side of the arm, a socket is formed on the outer surface of the bottom of the arm, and is electrically connected with an action command terminal of the robot, thebottom end of the arm is fixedly connected with a base, locking buckles are respectively fixedly connected with the left side and the right side, close to the arm, of the upper surface of the base, asucking disc is fixedly connected with the interior of the base, the bottom of the base is fixedly connected with a fixed block, and clamping slots are formed in the bottom and one side surface of thefixed block respectively. The composite fixture used for the industrial robot has the advantages that adsorption and grabbing of a large-size object and adsorption of the fixed block are realized byarranging the sucking disc; the fixed block is further fixed by arranging the locking buckles and combining the sucking disc; the fixture can be conveniently replaced by arranging corresponding clamping slots and clamping blocks as well as a fixing lock; and multiple work types of machines can be fixed at the bottom of each clamping block, so that the aim that multiple fixtures are integrated intoa whole is realized.
source_title: Composite fixture used for industrial robot

abstract: The invention relates to a planning method for smooth transition between linear tracks of a self-driven articulated arm measuring machine. Pose information and the constraint conditions are input into an acceleration and deceleration algorithm and an arc transition model to obtain a transition trajectory, and the transition trajectory is combined with a linear trajectory to obtain a complete measurement trajectory. The angle, the speed and the angular speed of each joint are obtained by means of inverse kinematics and an inverse Jacobian matrix, joint space quintic polynomial interpolation is carried out at the abrupt change position of the speed, the continuity and smoothness of the speed and the acceleration are ensured, the self-driven articulated arm measuring machine is prevented from being impacted by the abrupt change of the speed and the acceleration, and the measuring precision is improved. According to the planning method, high-precision measurement of the self-driven articulated arm measuring machine can be realized, and the method can also be applied to trajectory planning of an industrial robot.
source_title: Planning method for smooth transition between linear tracks of self-driven articulated arm measuring machine

abstract: The invention discloses a data monitoring device for industrial robot machine vision, which adopts monitoring equipment, a contraction control mechanism and a hydraulic oil pipe opening and closing execution mechanism, and is characterized in that the contraction control mechanism is connected between the monitoring equipment and the hydraulic oil pipe opening and closing execution mechanism; and the monitoring equipment moves upwards and retracts into the contraction control mechanism, and meanwhile, when the monitoring equipment retracts into the contraction control mechanism, the hydraulic oil pipe opening and closing executing mechanism is controlled to move downwards so as to block the hydraulic oil pipe, and the hydraulic oil pipe is forced to stop working. According to the invention, the contraction control mechanism is adopted to effectively protect the monitoring equipment, the phenomenon of hard contact between the monitoring equipment and a product is avoided, and the monitoring equipment is effectively protected for the first time; meanwhile, a hydraulic oil pipe opening and closing executing mechanism is adopted to block a hydraulic oil pipe, the hydraulic oil pipe is forced to stop working, the industrial robot is controlled to stop working, and monitoring equipment is effectively protected for the second time; the automation degree is high, working efficiency is improved, and labor cost is reduced.
source_title: Data monitoring device for industrial robot machine vision

abstract: PURPOSE: A surgical robot system and a control method thereof are provided to smoothly perform an operation by displaying a virtual surgical instrument and an actual surgical instrument using augmented reality. CONSTITUTION: A surgical robot system comprises a master robot(1) and a slave robot(2). The master robot controls the slave robot remotely. The master robot comprises a storage unit, an augmented reality implementation unit(350), and an operation signal generator(340). The augmented reality implementation unit stores the user operation history for a virtual operation in the storage unit as the history information. A manipulation signal generator generates an operation signal using surgical history information and transmits the operation signal to the slave robot according to the application command.
source_title: SURGICAL ROBOT SYSTEM USING HISTORY INFORMATION AND CONTROL METHOD THEREOF

abstract: The invention provides a safety control method for position and torque alternation of a man-machine cooperation collision scene, and belongs to the field of industrial robots, and the method comprises the steps: S1, under a normal condition, enabling a robot to perform trajectory tracking in a position control mode, and continuously correcting a position error; s2, collision detection is conducted through a sliding mode control algorithm, and when a collision signal is detected, it is judged that the robot collides with the outside; s3, when it is detected that the robot collides, the robot is switched to a torque control mode, and an active buffering mechanism is started; s4, detecting whether the robot stops collision or not, if not, executing a torque mode, performing speed detection and torque detection, and starting a protection mechanism; if so, executing the step S5; and S5, when the robot is separated from the impact surface, the robot automatically returns to the position control mode and waits for standby. According to the invention, the safety and performance of the industrial robot working in the same space as people can be improved.
source_title: Safety control method for position and moment alternation of man-machine cooperation collision scene

abstract: The invention relates to a multi-DOF sensor for an industrial robot, which robot has at least two DOF. The multi-DOF sensor is arranged for sensing at least one force and is constituted by a plurality of one-DOF sensors (11, 12). A first end face of each one-DOF sensor (11, 12) is connected to a surface of a first body (31 a, 31 b) and a second end face of each one-DOF sensor (11, 12) is connected to a surface of a second body. The invention also relates to an industrial robot comprising the invented multi-DOF sensor.
source_title: A MULTI-DOF SENSOR FOR AN INDUSTRIAL ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses an automatic assembly production line of an industrial robot joint, the industrial robot joint comprises a shell, a speed reducer and a plurality of parts, and the automatic assembly production line comprises a first-stage line body, a second-stage line body and a third-stage line body which are in butt joint in sequence; wherein the first-stage line body is used for feeding a shell; the secondary line body is used for assembling the speed reducer and the shell to obtain a semi-finished joint product; and the third-stage line body is used for mounting a plurality of parts on the joint semi-finished product according to a preset mounting rule so as to obtain a joint finished product, and discharging the joint finished product. According to the technical scheme, the joints of the industrial robot are assembled in an automatic mode, compared with a manual assembly mode, the production efficiency of the joints of the industrial robot is greatly improved, the large-batch and high-quality production requirements of manufacturers can be met, and the production benefits are greatly improved.
source_title: Automatic assembly production line and method for industrial robot joints and storage medium

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control, and discloses an industrial robot control device and system based on control integration, and the device and system are characterized inthat a teaching control integration module is connected with a driving module and is used for controlling a robot body in real time and carrying out man-machine interaction; the driving module is usedfor driving the robot body. A control command is sent to the robot body through a key or a touch screen; when the control command is received, and manual and automatic related operation control overthe robot can be completed; a step of feeding back the state data is carried out, and the state of the robot is displayed by using the touch screen. The invention provides the handheld robot control device which is low in cost, high in performance and easy to operate. According to the invention, a real-time control function is added to a traditional demonstrator unit, so that the demonstrator hasteaching and control functions, an independent controller is reduced, the size of a control box is reduced, and normal operation experience is ensured under the condition of providing the same functional performance.
source_title: Industrial robot control device and system based on control integration

abstract: This method allows, by associating an imprecise low-range power actuator 5 with an actuator 3 of low power in comparison with the first, the play of the power actuator to be taken up to ensure good quality positioning 1 by acting on one and the same articulation 2. The method according to the invention can be applied to mechanical systems where good precision in the positioning of a spindle is required (manipulation arm, industrial robot spindle). <IMAGE>
source_title: Method for fine-positioning articulated systems by the association of actuators of different powers

abstract: The invention relates to the field of robot control, and discloses a mobile station for sleeving a protective sleeve, and the mobile station comprises a base which can move relative to the ground; the at least one sleeving arm is arranged on the base; the actuator is arranged at the tail end of at least one sleeving arm and used for keeping the opening of the protective sleeve; and the control device is connected with the base and the at least one sleeving arm and is configured to obtain the pose of at least one part of the surgical robot, generate an actuator movement path for the actuator based on the pose of at least one part of the surgical robot and control the base and/or the at least one sleeving arm to move, and the protective sleeve is sleeved on at least one part of the surgical robot by the actuator along the movement path of the actuator.
source_title: Mobile station for sleeving protective sleeve and robot system

abstract: The OLED screen automatic assembling equipment based on robot operation comprises an assembling line, the assembling line comprises a bottom plate, the two ends of the top of the bottom plate are fixedly connected with outer supporting plates correspondingly, and an upper feeding mechanism is installed on one side of the top end of each outer supporting plate and fixedly connected with a transmission belt correspondingly; the two sides of the top end of the bottom plate are fixedly connected with inner supporting plates respectively, the top ends of the inner supporting plates are fixedly connected with lower feeding mechanisms respectively, the two ends of each lower feeding mechanism are fixedly connected with transmission belts respectively, the two ends of the bottom of each lower feeding mechanism are slidably clamped with guide sliding grooves respectively, and the guide sliding grooves are formed in the opposite end faces of the inner supporting plates respectively. The center of the top end of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with an electric telescopic rod, the electric telescopic rod is fixedly connected with a bearing plate used for jacking materials, and the transmission belt drives the upper feeding mechanism and the lower feeding mechanism to synchronously and oppositely move or synchronously and reversely move. According to the assembly line, the OLED screens are pasted and assembled, overall automatic operation is achieved, manual participation is reduced, and the assembly efficiency is improved.
source_title: OLED screen automatic assembling equipment based on robot operation

abstract: The invention provides a building construction carrying industrial robot, and belongs to the technical field of building machinery, the building construction carrying industrial robot comprises a frame, a carrying assembly and moving assemblies, and the carrying assembly is arranged on the frame; a plurality of moving assemblies are arranged; each moving assembly comprises a first supporting leg with one end movably connected with the frame, a second supporting leg movably connected with the other end of the first supporting leg, and a roller assembly arranged at the end, away from the first supporting leg, of the second supporting leg. According to the building construction carrying industrial robot provided by the invention, the moving assembly has two motion modes. And in the actual operation process, the moving modes can be switched at any time according to different terrains, and the trafficability of the building construction carrying industrial robot in the complex terrain environment is improved.
source_title: Building construction carrying industrial robot

abstract: The invention discloses an industrial robot with a gear backlash adjuster, comprising a base. The upper end of the base is symmetrically provided with a plurality of threaded holes; a box is fixedly connected to the upper end of the base; a shell is welded to the upper end of the box; a driving mechanism is arranged in the box. The industrial robot has the advantages that elasticity of powerful springs and pull of pull springs enable a connection gear, a driving gear and a driven gear to effectively engage together even when abraded, so that backlashes are avoided; a handle can be rotated to adjust the position of the connection gear, thereby decreasing the backlashes between the connection gear and the driving gear and driven gear, and preventing the problem that insufficient elasticity of the powerful springs and insufficient pull of the pull springs cause failure of elimination of gear backlashes; an observation hole helps a worker to perform maintaining conveniently, so that the worker can adjust the backlashes more precisely.
source_title: Industrial robot with gear backlash adjuster

abstract: The invention discloses a wireless automatic inspection robot for a mine belt conveyor. The wireless automatic inspection robot comprises a support plate, and connecting plates are fixedly arranged onthe two sides of two ends of the support plate. A support device is fixedly arranged under the end, far away from the support plate, of each connecting plate. A sliding rod is fixedly arranged underthe support plate, and a sliding block is glidingly arranged on the outer wall of the sliding rod in a sleeved mode. A driving device is arranged on the sliding block, and a box is fixedly arranged under the sliding block. A lithium battery, a safety barrier, a processor and a wireless bridge are arranged in the box, and a camera, an LED lamp and a smoke sensor are fixedly arranged under the box.The camera, the LED lamp, the smoke sensor and the wireless bridge are electrically connected with the processor. The wireless automatic inspection robot has the beneficial effects of realizing automatic inspection for the mine belt conveyor, reducing the labor intensity of inspection workers, improving the inspection efficiency, and increasing the safety performance of inspection.
source_title: Wireless automatic inspection robot for mine belt conveyor

abstract: The invention relates to an industrial robot health state evaluation method based on multi-modal servo information mapping. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining the influence of a complex service condition on the performance of an industrial robot and a degradation mechanism; health perception features are extracted from multi-mode servo information collected in the operation process of the industrial robot; according to the collected health perception characteristics, a health perception model of the industrial robot under the complex working condition is established; an incremental learning model is established, a degradation model is obtained along with continuous addition, continuous learning and updating of new data, failure time distribution of the degradation model is predicted, decision support is provided for maintenance of industrial robot equipment, and a multi-modal servo information mapping model is constructed by deeply analyzing a performance degradation mechanism of an industrial robot under complex working conditions. And accurate sensing of the health state of the robot is realized. And a self-supervised contrast representation learning theory is utilized to solve the problem of fault sample deficiency, and the accuracy of health perception is improved. Based on an incremental learning theory of multi-modal servo information, an autonomous diagnosis model is established, and rapid diagnosis and performance degradation prediction of a new fault are realized.
source_title: Industrial robot health state assessment method based on multi-modal servo information mapping

abstract: The invention discloses an industrial robot control system and method based on big data, and a mobile control platform and method based on an intelligent algorithm. An industrial robot equipment data acquisition assembly is arranged on a production line industrial robot to acquire equipment data of the industrial robot in different states and is used for detecting industrial robot equipment data when a product is close to the industrial robot, and the industrial robot equipment data is sent to a cloud super computing platform in an industrial robot monitoring and decision-making assembly; the industrial robot monitoring and decision-making assembly comprises a cloud super-computing platform, and the cloud super-computing platform is used for determining the machining relation between a product corresponding to the industrial robot equipment data and the industrial robot according to the industrial robot equipment data and sending the machining relation to the matched intelligent display screen; the control problem of an existing industrial robot can be solved.
source_title: Industrial robot control system and method based on big data

abstract: The invention discloses a cooperative scheduling method of an industrial robot scheduling system, and relates to the technical field of cooperative scheduling, and the method comprises the steps: recording each robot participating in a scheduling task as a target robot, and obtaining a path transmission quality imbalance coefficient, a queuing coefficient and a transmission signal attenuation coefficient between the target robot and other target robots; a communication delay coefficient is obtained according to the path transmission quality imbalance coefficient, the queuing coefficient and the transmission signal attenuation coefficient, and communication delays between the target robot and other target robots are divided into different grades by combining a preset threshold value; and different optimization measures are adopted according to different communication delay levels to assist the cooperative scheduling of the industrial robot scheduling system, so that the communication delay between the industrial robots can be detected and corrected, timely task coordination and no data distortion are ensured, the influence on the execution efficiency of the overall assembly task is reduced, and the efficiency of the whole assembly task is improved. The production line stability and the product quality are ensured.
source_title: Cooperative scheduling method of industrial robot scheduling system

abstract: The invention relates to an electrical drive (13) and an industrial robot (1) that comprises at least one such electrical drive (13), having: an electric motor (14) that comprises a motor housing (15), a drive shaft (18) rotatably mounted by means of at least two roller bearings (21, 22), a stator (16) secured in said motor housing (15), and a rotor (17) that is connected to said drive shaft (18) and can rotate in said motor housing (15); as well as a harmonic drive gear (19) that comprises a gear housing (20), a circular spline (23) with an inner toothing (24), a flex spline (25) that has an outer toothing (26), and a wave generator (27) that can be rotated in the gear housing (20) and that rolls on the flex spline (25), said outer toothing (26) of the flex spline (25) engaging with the inner toothing (24) of the circular spline (23) such that they become meshed as a function of a rotational movement of the wave generator (27). The rotor (17) is secured on the drive shaft (18), and a first of said at least two roller bearings (21, 22) is arranged inside the flex spline (25) and is designed to mount said drive shaft (18) such that it can rotate inside the gear housing (20).
source_title: ELECTRICAL DRIVE AND INDUSTRIAL ROBOT COMPRISING AT LEAST ONE SUCH ELECTRICAL DRIVE

abstract: The invention provides an industrial robot teaching programming system and method based on a 3D joystick. The industrial robot teaching programming system comprises the 3D joystick, a main controller, an industrial robot and a force sensor. The teaching programming process comprises the following steps. The method comprises the following steps: S1, establishing a mapping relation between a 3D operating lever and the tail end of a mechanical arm of a corresponding industrial robot, and enabling the moving and rotating ranges of the 3D operating lever to be in one-to-one correspondence with the working range of the robot; s2, designing a position control ring based on contact force to realize stability of the contact force; s3, correcting accidental errors and personal errors in the teaching process; s4, operating a 3D control rod to change the pose of the industrial robot; s5, collecting a teaching track; s6, judging whether the teaching is finished or not; if not, continuing to operate for teaching, and if so, ending the teaching through a program, and carrying out the next operation; step S7, the teaching track is reproduced; the working state of the specific robot with any shaft linkage can be set, the universality is higher, and the robot is simpler and more convenient.
source_title: Industrial robot teaching programming system and method based on 3D joystick

abstract: The industrial robot assembly (10) has an industrial robot (12), with an emergency current loop (14), an emergency switch (16), and an emergency stop module (18). The emergency stop module has a current loop (20) with an emergency stop input (22) for the connection of the emergency stop switch. An industrial robot connection (24) connects the industrial robot current loop and an emergency stop module connection (26) for connecting another identical emergency stop module. An independent claim is also included for an industrial robot emergency stop module for an assembly.
source_title: Industrial robot assembly has industrial robot, with emergency current loop, emergency switch, and emergency stop module, which has current loop with emergency stop input for connection of emergency stop switch

abstract: Disclosed is an eating assistant robot using a conveyor. The eating assistant robot comprises: a plurality of trays which receives foods by size, which are cut in predetermined shapes and sizes and has an outlet port for allowing the foods to pass through; a discharging means for discharging the foods from the trays; a delivering means for transferring the foods discharged by the discharging means into a predetermined position; a robot arm which is coupled to the handle of a spoon at one end and loads the foods delivered by the delivering means on a food receiving part of the spoon; and an arm control unit which controls the robot arm and loads the foods delivered by the delivering means on the food receiving part of the spoon. The eating assisting robot is simply operated and is cheaply manufactured. [Reference numerals] (110) Tray;(120) Discharging means;(130) Delivering means;(140) Robot arm;(150) Arm control unit;(160) Control unit
source_title: Meal assistance robot using a conveyor

abstract: PURPOSE:To perform the shift control of an industrial robot with no temporary stop nor the collision against an obstacle, by securing a curve shift where a shift route decided from the synthesization of speed components of an optimum speed pattern has the smooth variation of speed according to the result of synthesization of the orthogonal components of a mobile plane. CONSTITUTION:For instance, mobile spots P0-P3 are supplied in the form of data. Then each distance among these spots is calculated, and the speed components are synthesized in terms of a mobile plane for independent coordinate axis directions, i.e., horizontal two axes and a vertical optimum speed pattern. Then shift speeds are calculated on a mobile route and at a prescribed spot on the mobile route. Based on these data, the shift of a robot is controlled. For the optimum speed pattern, an acceleration section (a) is equal to a curve part formed by synthesizing a sign curve immediately before the rise of the speed is linear and enters a fixed speed section (b) with these sections (a) and (b) and a deceleration section (c) in the axial direction and in a linear section between the spots P0 and P1. Then a curve is obtained with synthesization of the sign curve in the section (c) following the section (b). Thus a smooth end is secured with the robot shift.
source_title: SHIFT CONTROLLER OF INDUSTRIAL ROBOT

abstract: A robotic system employing a plurality of surgical robots (20) and a surgical procedure controller (22)for executing a surgical procedure on an anatomical structure (e.g., a heart) within an anatomical region(e.g., a thoracic region). In operation, controller (22) autonomously controls a navigation of each surgical robot (20) within the anatomical region relative to the anatomical structure by directing a navigation of each surgical robot (20) within the anatomical region relative to the anatomical structure based on a surgical plan for executing the surgical procedure on the anatomical structure (e.g., a convergent ablation plan consisting of an epicardial ablation plan for abating an exterior of a heart and an endocardial ablation plan for ablating an interior of the heart) and further by revising the surgical plan responsive to a partial or complete inability of one or more of the surgical robots (20) to be navigated within the anatomical region relative to the anatomical structure based on the surgical plan.
source_title: IMAGE GUIDED ROBOTIC CONVERGENT ABLATION

abstract: The invention provides a control method, device and equipment for robot constant-force deburring and a storage medium. Firstly, impedance characteristics of a workpiece to be machined are obtained, and a mapping model of the impedance characteristics and coordinate changes is established; thirdly, inputting the mapping model into a trained BP neural network to predict and generate a control signal for controlling a deburring end effector; then, the industrial robot is driven based on the control signal, and the real-time impedance characteristic detected by the deburring end effector is obtained in real time; and finally, according to the real-time impedance characteristic, attitude offset generated after rigid contact of the end effector is generated, and the attitude offset is compensated through a point position interpolation method. The problem that due to the fact that the feeding motion of an end effector possibly causes large extrusion acting force, the posture of a machining path deviates is solved.
source_title: Control method, device and equipment for robot constant-force deburring and storage medium

abstract: A robotic automated filling and capping system is made up of a cartridge infeed conveyor, a cap infeed conveyor, an outfeed conveyor, a six-axis robot, and a selective compliance articulated robot arm, all of which are configured to work together to automatically, and sanitarily, fill and cap vape oil cartridges.
source_title: ROBOTIC AUTOMATED FILLING AND CAPPING SYSTEM FOR VAPE OIL CARTRIDGES

abstract: The invention relates to a correction method for correcting conveyor tracking information, a correction system, and a storage medium, which can accurately set conveyor tracking information without stopping a conveyor. The correction method according to the present invention comprises the steps of: (a) temporarily setting conveyor tracking information; (b) acquiring a reference image, a first image, and a second image by capturing an image of a reference object carried on the conveyor at three capturing timings while the conveyor is moving at a fixed speed; (c) analyzing the three images to obtain measurement coordinate values of the reference position, the first position and the second position in the robot coordinate system; and (d) correcting the temporary setting value of the conveyor tracking information so as to match the position and action of the conveyor indicated by the conveyor tracking information with various measurement results.
source_title: Correction method and correction system for correcting tracking information of conveyor and storage medium

abstract: A method of controlling movements of an industrial robot (12) in relation to a surface (28), the method comprising providing a plurality of candidate target points (56a-56f) for the industrial robot in an offline programming system (14); providing a plurality of actual reference points (70; 70a-70e) in the offline programming system, the actual reference points being indicative of a true profile of the surface; modifying the candidate target points in the offline programming system based on the actual reference points to provide a plurality of modified target points (72; 72a-72f) for the industrial robot; providing a target robot program (52) for the industrial robot based on the modified target points; and executing the target robot program in a robot controller (16) to thereby cause the industrial robot to perform movements in relation to the surface.
source_title: METHOD OF CONTROLLING MOVEMENTS OF INDUSTRIAL ROBOT, AND ROBOT SYSTEM

abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a robot motion control method and device, electronic equipment and a medium. The method comprises the steps that acquired path points are analyzed, and robot control compensation instructions are obtained, wherein the robot control compensation instructions comprise position compensation instructions and/or speed compensation instructions; a position loop and/or a speed loop of a servo three-loop feedback control system are/is compensated according to the robot control compensation instructions; and a robot is controlled to move based on the compensated servo three-loop feedback control system. By executing the technical scheme, the technical effect of improving the response speed, the track precision, the motion stability and other dynamic characteristics of the industrial robot can be achieved.
source_title: Robot motion control method and device, electronic equipment and medium

abstract: The invention discloses an industrial robot anti-collision control system and method. The signal state of a second input signal end is detected in real time through a system controller so that whether an industrial robot makes contact with a protected object or not can be determined, when the signal state is high level, it is indicated that the protected object makes contact with the industrial robot, then the system controller immediately sends a motion pause control command to a robot controller, and the robot controller controls the industrial robot to stop moving based on the motion pause control command, so that the safety of the protected object is guaranteed, potential safety hazards are eliminated, and all-directional collision detection and control protection of the industrial robot are realized.
source_title: Industrial robot anti-collision control system and method

abstract: The invention discloses a rapid visual positioning method for an industrial robot, and relates to the technical field of rapid positioning of industrial robots, and the method comprises the steps: collecting depth image data and color image data of a target object through an image collection module, and extracting and preprocessing the collected depth image data and color image data through an image processing module; a target detection and recognition module is adopted to analyze the processed depth image data and color image data, feature information of a target object needing to be processed is recognized, and based on the target detection and recognition module, comprehensive adjustment of rapid visual positioning is carried out through a comprehensive positioning adjustment module. And the comprehensive positioning and adjusting module comprises a depth image visual coarse positioning unit, a color image feature recognition and adjusting unit and a comprehensive positioning and adjusting unit, and is used for uploading collected image data to an industrial robot control system terminal.
source_title: Rapid visual positioning method for industrial robot

abstract: The invention provides an industrial robot, a control method and device thereof and a readable storage medium, the industrial robot comprises a joint driver, a motor and a connecting rod, the joint driver drives the motor to drive the connecting rod to move, and the control method comprises the steps that first control information is received; discrete points in the first path information are obtained, the discrete points are associated with a planned speed curve, and the first path information is path information corresponding to the first control information; the corresponding relation between the vibration suppression parameters of the motor and the discrete points is obtained when the joint driver operates according to the speed curve; under the condition that the joint target position is received, position increment information corresponding to the joint target position is determined based on the corresponding relation; and controlling the motor to operate based on the position increment information.
source_title: Industrial robot, control method and device thereof and readable storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses a pipeline fixing structure and an industrial robot, the pipeline fixing structure is applied to the industrial robot, the industrial robot comprises a body, and the pipeline fixing structure comprises a fixing part used for being connected with the body; the pressing piece is connected with the fixing piece, and the fixing piece and the pressing piece are matched to form a containing cavity for a pipeline to penetrate through; and the elastic piece is filled in the accommodating cavity so as to compress the pipeline in the accommodating cavity. According to the technical scheme, the technical problem of unreliable cable fixation is solved.
source_title: Pipeline fixing structure and industrial robot

abstract: The present invention provides an industrial robot which transports a predetermined transport object and can reduce the possibility of collision between a hand and a surrounding structure or the likewhen an arm stretches out and draws back. The industrial robot is provided with an arm, an arm supporting part (24) and a base table (9), wherein the arm can stretch and retract in the horizontal direction so that a hand can move approximately linearly in a state of facing a certain direction; the arm supporting part (24) is rotatably connected with the base end side of the arm; when the arm is stretched out and drawn back in a manner that the hand moves approximately linearly towards the accommodating part for accommodating the object to be conveyed, the position of the arm supporting part (24) relative to the rotating direction of the base (9) is set as an arm stretching-out and drawing-back permissible position. An industrial robot is provided with a detection mechanism (33) for detecting the presence of an arm support part (24) at an arm extension/retraction permissible position. The detection mechanism (33) is provided with a sensor mounted on a base (9) and a detection member mounted on the arm support part (24).
source_title: Industrial robot

abstract: The invention provides a man-machine cooperation safety control method and system for an industrial robot. The man-machine cooperation safety control method for the industrial robot comprises the steps that parameter configuration and initialization are conducted on sensor equipment of the industrial robot; environment data in the operation process of the industrial robot are collected in real time through sensor equipment of the industrial robot; analyzing the environmental data in the operation process of the industrial robot by using a neural network model to obtain static obstacles and dynamic obstacles appearing in the surrounding environment of the industrial robot; and the obstacle information of the dynamic obstacle and the static obstacle is sent to a controller of the industrial robot, and the industrial robot is controlled to avoid the static obstacle and the dynamic obstacle. The system comprises modules corresponding to the steps of the method.
source_title: Man-machine cooperation safety control method and system for industrial robot

abstract: A stitch machining method by an industrial robot capable of performing a teaching operation easily and the stitch machining accurately. Instead of teaching switchover points p1, P2,... for application and non-application of sealant in sealing as shown in FIG. 5a, a distance n1 of a machining section (where sealant is applied) and a distance n2 of a non-machining section are set to a robot controller as shown in FIG. 5b. The robot controller monitors a travel distance and switches from machining to non-machining and vice versa each time the robot travels the distance n1 and the distance n2, respectively, to thereby effect the stitch machining. As shown in FIGS. 5c and 5g, it is possible to ensure that a start and an end points of each block are positioned in the machining sections n1. Further, as shown in FIG. 5d, the stitch machining can be performed continuously for a plurality of blocks. As shown in FIG. 5f, the stitch machining can be performed in each block with a set number of cycles of machining and non-machining. <IMAGE>
source_title: STITCH PROCESSING METHOD USING INDUSTRIAL ROBOT

abstract: An intelligent visual flexible line system based on an industrial robot comprises a machine vision module, a robot module, an automatic module, a safety module, an expansion interface module and a plurality of functional modules, wherein the expansion interface module comprises a communication interface, a development interface and a mechanical interface; the multiple functional modules include detachable mechanical arms and detachable mechanical legs; and the expansion interfaces are adaptable to the multiple functional modules so that a robot can be transformed in different ways in differentapplication scenes, and control over the start and movement of the robot is achieved. The intelligent visual flexible line system is provided with the robot, the multiple expansion interfaces and themultiple functional modules, so that the problems that traditional robots can only be specially manufactured according to special requirements and cannot adapt to changes of automatic assembly lines,an industrial robot is poor in expandability and flexibility, and a large quantity of manpower and material resources are wasted are solved.
source_title: Intelligent visual flexible line system based on industrial robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a method for reducing the energy consumption of an industrial robot comprising a manipulator (8) having a plurality of arms that are movable relative each other about a plurality of axes. The method comprises: defining a model for the energy consumption of the robot dependent on the movements of the axes of the robot, including a relation between the energy consumed due to friction and the speed of the axes, and the energy consumed due to gravity acting on the arms considering the fact that the energy consumed due to gravity can be reduced during standstill one or more of the axes if the axes are mechanically locked, storing a control program specifying a geometric path to be followed by the robot, determining, during at least a part of the work cycle, speed profiles for the axes of the robot when following the specified geometric path with regard to minimizing the energy consumption of the robot and determining whether or not an axis should be mechanically locked during standstill in order to reduce the energy consumption, based on said model for the energy consumption of the robot, and a maximum allowed time for carrying out the robot movement during said part of the work cycle, provided that it is permitted to complete the geometric path in a shorter time than the maximum allowed time, and calculating reference values for the motors of the robot based on the determined speed profiles.
source_title: A METHOD FOR REDUCING THE ENERGY CONSUMPTION OF AN INDUSTRIAL ROBOT AND AN INDUSTRIAL ROBOT SYSTEM

abstract: A robot based on battery sorting system comprises: an industrial robot (10), a sorting gripper (20) controlled by the industrial robot (10) for crawling a plurality of batteries (90) to the specified location; and a calibrating device (30) controlled by the industrial robot (10) for calibrating the position of the batteries. The sorting gripper (20) comprises a plurality of grippers (21) which are controlled by the industrial robot (10) to grip the selected batteries. The calibrating device (30) comprises a battery calibrating board (31). The battery calibrating board (31) is provided with a plurality of cavities (311) which are used for accommodating a plurality of batteries (90). The relative position of the plurality of cavities (311) is used for calibrating the relative position of the plurality of batteries (90).
source_title: ROBOT BASED BATTERY SORTING SYSTEM

abstract: The invention provides a grinding robot force/position hybrid control method and system considering error constraints. The method comprises the steps that a model of contact force between an end effector of a grinding robot and the environment is established; the actual contact force between the environment and the robot end effector is obtained based on the model, and the target position in the force control direction is adjusted according to the error between the actual contact force and the target contact force, so that the actual contact force can track the target contact force; position control is achieved through a high-precision servo driver packaged in the industrial robot. According to the method and system, in consideration of unmodeled dynamics such as difficulty in obtaining an accurate value of environment rigidity, certain uncertainty and unknown disturbance in an actual grinding system, a contact force model when the robot end effector is in contact with the environment is provided, so that description of the contact force is closer to the actual situation. The force/position hybrid control method provided by the invention can realize accurate trajectory tracking and force tracking, and ensures that the force tracking error is always within a set limit.
source_title: Grinding robot force/position hybrid control method and system considering error constraint

abstract: What is described is a robotic system of the type comprising a multi-axis industrial robot (1) having a base structure (2), an articulated robot wrist (10), a chain of mutually articulated robot elements connecting the base structure (2) to the robot wrist (10), and means for controlling the movement of the robot (1) so that positions within a predetermined operating space of the robot can be reached by means of the wrist (10). The system also comprises a head (35) fixed to the robot wrist (10) and including a telemetric device (40) with three laser measuring devices (40a, 40b, 40c) and a passive video camera (50a) viewing device (50), both incorporated in the head (35), for the seeking, recognition, relative orientation and/or following of targets (30) or other similar objective signs associated with respective objects (20) or with surface portions of these objects (20) present in the operating space of the robot (1).
source_title: ROBOTIC SYSTEM COMPRISING A TELEMETRIC DEVICE WITH A LASER MEASURING DEVICE AND A PASSIVE VIDEO CAMERA

abstract: The invention discloses a robot self-calibration program correction algorithm, and relates to the technical field of industrial robots. The robot self-calibration program correction algorithm comprises the steps that a calibration object is placed at a designated position; controlling the robot to enable the tail end of the robot to move to the calibration object in various different postures, and recording the joint values of the calibration points corresponding to the various different postures; converting the joint values of the calibration points corresponding to the various different postures into a plurality of corresponding Cartesian points; and calculating and correcting the moving precision of the tail end of the robot according to the Cartesian points. The original tail end precision of the robot can be quickly recovered, and application expansion of the industrial robot is facilitated.
source_title: Robot self-calibration program correction algorithm

abstract: Provided is a medical system which is capable of showing a virtual image mid-air display having an input operation function such as a touch panel in an appropriate spatial position in an operating room. This system comprises: a mid-air display monitor 11 which displays an original image of a virtual image mid-air display 15 having an input operation function such as a touch panel; a mid-air display plate 12 for displaying the virtual image mid-air display; a movable robot arm 13 that moves the mid-air display monitor 11; a gesture sensor 14 that detects positional directional information of a predetermined part of a practitioner (operator) 100 and of equipment and the like in the operating room; and a system controller 3 which drives and controls the mid-air display monitor 11 and the movable robot arm 13 on the basis of the information and shows the virtual image mid-air display 15 in a predetermined space.
source_title: MEDICAL SYSTEM

abstract: The invention provides a 3D visual grabbing and carrying system for a robot to automatically store and take a source tank, and relates to the technical field of grabbing and carrying of six-axis industrial robots, the 3D visual grabbing and carrying system comprises the six-axis industrial robot, a camera support is arranged on one side of the six-axis industrial robot, and a 3D visual camera is installed on the surface of the camera support; a robot gripper is installed at one end of the six-axis industrial robot, a source transporting vehicle source cabin is arranged on one side of the six-axis industrial robot, and a neutron tank tray and a gamma tank tray are installed on the top of the source transporting vehicle source cabin. By arranging a six-axis industrial robot, a camera support, a 3D vision camera, a robot gripper, a source vehicle source cabin, a neutron tank tray, a gamma tank tray, a gamma tank body, a neutron tank body and a material disc, the problems that the parking position of a source vehicle is inaccurate, and the parking space is not accurate are solved through mutual combination of the six-axis industrial robot and the 3D vision camera; and the problem that the six-axis industrial robot cannot accurately grab the materials is solved.
source_title: 3D visual grabbing and carrying system for robot to automatically store and take source tanks

abstract: An industrial robot (10), a brake, and a state monitoring method. The industrial robot (10) comprises: a connecting rod (1) and a joint (2). The joint (2) comprises a drive motor (21) and a brake. The brake comprises: a brake member (24), a blocking member (22), and an electromagnet (23). The electromagnet (23) comprises an iron core (231) and a coil. The iron core (231) is in an attachment position or a release position on the basis of a power-on or a power-off state of the coil. The blocking member (22) is in a retracted state or an extended state on the basis of the position of the iron core (231). When the brake enters a braking state, the blocking member (22) is in an extended state to be fitted to the brake member (24) to limit the rotation of the brake member (24). The industrial robot (10) comprises: a signal acquisition module used for applying an excitation pulse to the electromagnet (23) to obtain an inductance of the electromagnet (23); and a signal processing module used for determining the position of the iron core (231) according to the inductance of the electromagnet (23), and determining whether the brake works normally.
source_title: INDUSTRIAL ROBOT, BRAKE, AND STATE MONITORING METHOD

abstract: PURPOSE:To make it possible to apply a method of storing the operation of a memory-reproduced arm, for example, a painting robot into an electric control panel, also to a production line wherein a conveyor cannot be moved only for teaching. CONSTITUTION:When the method is applied to a memory-reproduced painting machine (painting robot), a body 5 is stopped in a predetermined position and the painting machine 3 is moved to a position B1 in order to perform teaching by using a moving truck 12. Then, the operator starts moving a painting arm 8 from an origin. Data are stored one by one into the electric control panel 1 shifted for the teaching. At that time, the truck 12 moved by U by a motor 16 through a speed reducer 17 and gears 20-23, 26 whenever one point is stored. Thereafter, the truck 12 is moved as B1 B2 B3 to complete the teaching.
source_title: STORING OF OPERATION OF ARM

abstract: The invention relates to a robot system (1), to a corresponding method, and to a processing system, wherein, along a process line (2, 19, 22, 26), which is formed by guide rails (20, 23), or on a conveyor belt (6), objects (4, 10, 11, 15) or workpieces are optionally moved or transported on carrier devices (5, 12, 14) having gripping elements (13, 16). The robot arm (7) removes the objects (4, 10, 11, 15) from the process line by pulling or pushing the objects from a plane or surface of the process line into a working chamber (17) compliantly, i.e., in a non-rigid manner by means of force control, wherein the objects are positioned and oriented in the working chamber by means of guiding elements (18). After the processing of the objects (4, 10, 11, 15) in the working chamber (7), the objects are pushed or pulled back onto the process line (2, 19, 22, 26) by means of the robot arm (7). The process line (2, 19, 22, 26) can comprise passive, non-driven rollers or the like instead of an actively driven conveyor belt (6), wherein the robot arm (7) nudges or pushes the objects (4, 10, 11, 15) in order to transport the objects.
source_title: ROBOT SYSTEM, METHOD FOR CONTROLLING A ROBOT SYSTEM, AND PROCESSING SYSTEM

abstract: The invention provides an automatic derusting system and method for a truck body of a gondola truck, and relates to the technical field of vehicle overhauling, the automatic derusting system comprises a truss structure, the truss structure comprises a three-axis moving assembly, and the three-axis moving assembly is arranged above the truck body in a crossing mode; the industrial robot is arranged on the three-axis moving assembly; the pneumatic chipping hammer is arranged on a mechanical arm of the industrial robot and is used for removing rust on the surface of the vehicle body; the camera system and the mechanical arm keep a fixed pose relationship; and the control system is connected with the industrial robot and the camera system and is used for acquiring and processing the information acquired by the camera system so as to generate a control instruction for the industrial robot. Compared with an existing manual rust removal mode, automatic and unmanned rust removal can be achieved, and the labor intensity of operators is greatly reduced.
source_title: Automatic derusting system and method for truck body of open wagon

abstract: The invention discloses an industrial robot balance control system and control method, and belongs to the technical field of industrial robots. An industrial robot balance control system comprises a sensor module used for obtaining the current state and environment information of a robot and connected with the industrial robot; the attitude estimation module is used for estimating the attitude of the robot based on the data transmitted by the sensor module, and the attitude estimation module is connected with the sensor module; and a decision planning module. According to the balance control system for the industrial robot, the attitude estimation module can provide real-time attitude information of the robot, such as an inclination angle, a rotation angle and a position, so that the system can quickly adjust the attitude of the robot to keep stable, and the attitude estimation module can filter noise and interference of a sensor and provide reliable attitude information, so that the system is more reliable. And the robustness and the stability of the system in a complex environment are enhanced.
source_title: Industrial robot balance control system and control method

abstract: A robotic system has been designed that can be used as a minimally invasive surgical device. The system has a master end and a slave end. The master end has five physical movements corresponding to physical movements at the slave end with five degrees of freedom. There is force feedback from the slave end to the master end for each physical movement. The interface can be one or more computers. The master end can be remote from the slave end and the slave end can be a surgical robot or a simulation program on a computer.
source_title: FORCE REFLECTIVE ROBOTIC CONTROL SYSTEM AND MINIMALLY INVASIVE SURGICAL DEVICE

abstract: The invention discloses a robot precision control method coupling kinematics and rigidity parameter identification, and belongs to the technical field of industrial robot precision compensation. The method is characterized in that errors of an industrial robot kinematics parameter correcting robot motion model are identified, robot rigidity modeling is realized through a rigidity identification method, operation load is dynamically sensed on line by combining a six-dimensional force sensor, a two-order compensation scheme for compensation for robot geometric errors and flexible errors under aload state is disclosed, and precise positioning of a robot under the working condition state is realized. The robot geometric errors and the flexible errors are precisely calculated, so that high precision control on absolute positioning errors of the robot under the processing state is realized, and technical needs of high-precision processing fields of hole-making, milling and the like of the robot are met.
source_title: Robot precision control method coupling kinematics and rigidity parameter identification

abstract: An industrial robot has a base and the mechanical links of a shoulder, arm and hand joined in series with a waist joint, shoulder joint, wrist roll joint and wrist pivot joint. A clutch mechanism is associated with each joint, and continuously spinning shafting extends through all the links and joints. The clutch mechanisms each take power upon electronic command from the shafting to power the joints and move the links relative to each other.
source_title: Continuous shaft-driven industrial robot

abstract: The invention relates to an operating device (2), such as an industrial robot. The operating device can bear the force and moment of a load; the device is provided with at least one operating arm (4).The device is provided with at least two arm bodies (6) which can move relative to each other. The robot is provided with at least one joint (8) arranged between two arm bodies (6). Wherein the two arm bodies (6) can be rotated relative to each other about a rotational or pivot axis (10) by means of the joint, and having at least one drive unit (12), the device comprises at least one electromagnetic driving device (14). Wherein the electromagnetic drive means are arranged on the actuating arm (4) in the region of the joint (8) and can be or is associated with the joint (8), wherein the stator(16) is arranged on one of the two arm bodies (6) in a rotationally fixed manner, and the rotor (18) is arranged on the other of the two arm bodies (6) in a rotationally fixed manner. The stator andthe rotor are rotatable relative to each other and fixable relative to each other about a rotational or pivoting axis (10) parallel to the joint (8), in particular a drive axis (20) extending in alignment with the rotational or pivoting axis.
source_title: MANIPULATOR DEVICE

abstract: The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and provides an industrial robot motion planning method which comprises the following steps: constructing a digital environment model containing a spatial topological relation by collecting real-time dynamic data of a working environment of an industrial robot; constructing a mixed deep learning model containing a graph convolutional network and a visual Transform module; generating a dynamic cost map containing safe passing area and obstacle area identifiers; based on the dynamic cost map, adopting a reinforcement learning decision algorithm to generate an initial motion path, and performing real-time path adjustment through a local planning algorithm; kinematics smoothing processing is carried out on the adjusted path, and a continuous motion track of each joint of the industrial robot is generated; and in the execution process, closed-loop correction is carried out on the continuous movement track of each joint of the industrial robot through feedback of the sensor, and the digital environment model is updated based on the correction result. According to the technical scheme, high-precision real-time motion planning of the robot in a dynamic environment can be realized.
source_title: Industrial robot motion planning method and device and storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses a control device of a cutting robot, and relates to the field of surgical robot auxiliary equipment, and the control device comprises a first connecting piece, a second connecting piece and a third connecting piece, one end of the second connecting piece is connected with the other end of the first connecting piece, the other end of the second connecting piece is connected with the scalpel through a third connecting piece, and the two ends of the first connecting piece, the two ends of the second connecting piece and the two ends of the third connecting piece are hinged; the rotating axes of the first connecting piece, the second connecting piece and the third connecting piece are parallel to one another; the rotating angles among the first connecting piece, the second connecting piece, the third connecting piece and the scalpel are controlled through the control unit; according to the control device, through hinged connection of the first connecting piece, the second connecting piece and the third connecting piece, the scalpel can keep moving on the same plane on the 3D printing guide plate, and the problem that it is difficult for a doctor to control the cutting plane is solved.
source_title: Control device of cutting robot

abstract: A swivel joint that is placed between a working device and a forwardly/reversely rotatable wrist section provided on a body section of an industrial robot and has a fluid transmission route for interconnecting the wrist section side and the working device side. The fluid transmission route is a hose, and between the wrist section and the working device, the hose is loosely spirally wound with a margin around a shaft section that rotates together with the wrist section. One end of the hose is non-rotatably fixed to the shaft section, and the other end is fixed so as to be movable with movement of the shaft section.
source_title: SWIVEL JOINT

abstract: Mechanism for driving a wrist of an industrial robot has a first wrist proximal region (13) which is supported at the distal end region of a robot arm (11) in such a manner as to be rotatable around a first axis ($g(g)) with respect to the distal end region. The first wrist proximal region (13) has a second wrist proximal region (14) which is rotatable around a second axis ($g(b)). The second wrist proximal region (14) has a wrist distal region (15) which is rotatable around a third axis ($g(a)). The robot arm (11) has a first power transmission unit (16) provided such as to extend in the longitudinal direction of the robot arm (11) and adapted to transmit rotational force to the first wrist proximal region (13). A second power transmission unit (19) for transmitting rotational force to the second wrist proximal region (14) is provided such as to extend along the robot arm (11) and the first wrist proximal region (13). The first wrist proximal region (13) is provided with a motor (25) for rotating the wrist distal region (15). The drive shaft of the motor (25) is connected to a first transmission shaft (26) which extends along the second axis ($g(b)). The first transmission shaft (26) is connected through a gear train (27) to a second transmission shaft (28) which extends along the third axis ($g(a)). The second transmission shaft (28) is connected to the wrist distal region (15). A reduction gear mechanism (31) is interposed in an intermediate region of the second transmission shaft (28).
source_title: MECHANISM FOR DRIVING WRIST OF INDUSTRIAL ROBOT.

abstract: A robotic welding system comprises a supporting arm for attaching to a repositionable support structure, the supporting arm comprising a first mounting portion connectable to the repositionable support structure, and a second mounting portion rotatably coupled to the first mounting portion. A yaw rotary actuator rotates the second mounting portion about a yaw axis. A welding arm comprises a third mounting portion rotatably coupled to the second mounting portion of the supporting arm. A pitch rotary actuator rotates the third mounting portion about a pitch axis generally perpendicular to the yaw axis. A roll rotary actuator rotates a torch holder shaft about a roll axis generally perpendicular to the pitch axis. The shaft has a torch mounting portion for mounting a welding torch at an end thereof. A controller is operably coupled to the actuators to cause the welding torch to execute a welding pattern.
source_title: Robotic welding system

abstract: The invention discloses a vision-based industrial robot kinematics calibration method in a large-size working space, solves the problem that an existing vision-based robot kinematics calibration method can only improve the absolute positioning precision of a robot in a limited space due to view field limitation, and belongs to the technical field of robot kinematics calibration. The method comprises the steps that according to configuration of the industrial robot, an ArUco mark is arranged in a working space; capturing an ArUco mark image by using a monocular vision system according to a set shooting path, and generating a full-coverage ArUco map; the robot uses a monocular vision system to capture ArUco mark images under different poses, a robot tail end absolute position model is constructed, and a measurement pose is obtained; calculating an error matrix of a tail end nominal pose and a measurement pose according to a robot joint angle and a kinematics parameter nominal value; and establishing a pose error model, and obtaining a robot kinematics parameter error according to the error matrix.
source_title: Industrial robot kinematics calibration method based on vision in large-size working space

abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent inspection robot for a wheel conveyor. The intelligent inspection robot comprises wheels, speed measurement encoders, a charging device, wheel shafts, towing trolley cross beams, a battery, a controller, a towing trolley bracket, an electronic gyroscope, a vibration sensor, a wireless transmission device, a thermal imager, a steel wire rope, a tension sensor, permanent magnets, stator parts and a remote centralized control device. According to the intelligent inspection robot, state monitoring units are innovatively integrated on towing trolleys of the wheel conveyor, so that the conveyor has the functions of real-time rotating speed output, track smoothness monitoring, steel wire rope tension monitoring, conveyor operation environment state monitoring and fault diagnosis, and meanwhile has the self-generating and charging functions; and the track state of the whole conveyor and the state of an operation line can be comprehensively perceived andmonitored, and the management level of a belt conveyor is improved.
source_title: Intelligent inspection robot for wheel conveyor

abstract: A method is disclosed, comprising: providing a part having a target at which an assembly operation is to be performed by an industrial robot; determining the target position, by controlling the end effector of the robot to approach the target, detecting a contact between a location utensil attached to the end effector and the target and controlling the end effector of the robot at least by force control until the location utensil reaches a predetermined position relative to the target, and determining the target position as indicated by the absolute position of the location utensil when the location utensil is in said predetermined position relative to the target; registering the target position; and controlling the end effector of the robot to perform the assembly operation at the registered target position. An assembly unit is also disclosed.
source_title: A METHOD AND AN ASSEMBLY UNIT FOR PERFORMING ASSEMBLING OPERATIONS

abstract: A robotic telesurgery portal system has a first robotic telesurgery portal at a first location, the first portal being couplable to a surgical robot and configured to: receive surgical video and robot control feedback data from the surgical robot; synchronize the video and robot control feedback data; transmit the surgical video and robot control feedback data; receive robot control information; and communicate robot control information to the surgical robot. The system also has a second robotic telesurgery portal at a second location, the second portal being couplable to a surgical robot control console and configured to: receive surgical video and robot control feedback data from the first robotic telesurgery portal; communicate the received surgical video and robot control feedback data to the surgical robot control console; receive robot control data; and transmit the received robot control data to the first robotic telesurgery portal.
source_title: ROBOTIC TELESURGERY PORTAL SYSTEM AND METHOD

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of heavy-load industrial robot safety assembly, solves the technical problem that a traditional method lacks effective judgment on real-time tracking of human body posture details and invasion of human body joints into dangerous areas, and particularly relates to a heavy-load industrial robot space safety man-machine cooperation control method. Comprising the steps of obtaining a transformation operator of a left camera in the depth camera relative to base coordinates; the human body posture is analyzed based on a YOLOv8-pose model to obtain a current output result containing the human body key point part, and a translation operator of the real-time visible human body key point part relative to a left camera in the depth camera is obtained. Compared with a traditional human-machine distance identification method, the human-machine distance identification method has the advantages that accurate position identification can be carried out on human joints, judgment is carried out through force sense and position estimation, the human-machine cooperation state can be sensed in an omnibearing mode, safety risks of human-machine cooperation are avoided to a certain extent, and the safety of operators is greatly improved.
source_title: Heavy-load industrial robot space safety man-machine cooperation control method

abstract: A surgical robot system and a method for controlling same are disclosed. A master interface for a surgical robot is mounted on a master robot that controls a slave robot having two or more robot arms equipped with respective surgical tools, wherein said master interface comprises: a screen display unit which displays images corresponding to the image signal inputted from a surgical endoscope; two or more arm-operating units which control said two or more robot arms, respectively; and a control unit which controls images in accordance with a user control such that the images can be displayed after being rotated in a predetermined direction, and which controls robot arm control conditions such that the conditions are updated to suit the rotated images. The master interface of the present invention enables the image displayed on a laparoscopic surgery monitor to be controlled in accordance with the intention of an operating surgeon during laparoscopic surgery, thereby preventing a lack of intuitiveness during surgery.
source_title: SURGICAL ROBOT SYSTEM, AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING SAME

abstract: The invention discloses a stokehole quick separation robot teaching method and related equipment, and relates to the technical field of industrial robot motion control, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the process precision requirement of a target process and the spatial constraint parameters of the work of a stokehole quick separation robot; according to the process precision requirement and the spatial constraint parameter, determining a working space category; determining a quantitative movement mode corresponding to the workspace category according to the workspace category; and an input signal of the man-machine interaction device is responded, and the moving process is executed according to the quantitative moving mode so as to complete teaching operation of the stokehole quick separation robot. By combining the process precision and the spatial constraint parameters, the quantitative movement mode is intelligently matched, high-precision, high-consistency and low-threshold standardized teaching operation can be realized, and the teaching efficiency and safety are remarkably improved.
source_title: Furnace front quick separation robot teaching method and related equipment

abstract: The invention relates to an industrial robot (1, 69) having at least one associated device (11), especially a sensor, which detects and/or detects and recognizes the working region of the industrial robot (1, 69). The aim of the invention is to improve the monitoring and identifying possibilities of the working region of the industrial robot. The industrial robot (1, 69) therefore comprises at least one working robot (2, R7), especially having a first manipulator arm (3), or manipulator and at least one assisting robot (4, R7a) and/or second manipulator arm (5) firmly coupled thereto and having the detecting device (11).
source_title: SENSOR ASSISTED INDUSTRIAL ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses a deceleration protecting method and system for a singular point area and an industrial robot. The method and system are applied to the industrial robot with multiple joints. The method specifically comprises the steps that target motion speed of the joints is calculated according to real-time state data and target state data of the joints of the industrial robot, wherein the real-time state data comprises the real-time motion angles and real-time time of the joints, and the target state data comprises target motion angles and target motion time which correspond to a preset motion task; the allowing position and allowing speed of the joints are calculated when the joints are located in a singular point transition area; deceleration protecting is performed on the joints according to the target motion speed and the allowing speed, that is, a controller is operated in time to perform deceleration when the motion speed of the joints in the singular point transition area exceeds the allowing speed to prevent overspeed from occurring, and therefore the halt or production safety problem generated due to the fact that the speed of the industrial robot in the singular point area is increased can be solved.
source_title: Deceleration protecting method and system for singular point area and industrial robot

abstract: The invention provides a global time optimal trajectory programming method of industrial robot dynamic speed regulation. The global time optimal trajectory programming method comprises the steps thattrajectory points which may overrun are detected in advance by a searching mechanism based on iterative backwards of a fixed searching range, the trajectory points are divided into three classes according to the overrun conditions, corresponding algorithms are provided by a nonlinear problem segmentation linear idea, and particularly when a joint deceleration overruns, pushback and nudge of the trajectory points and a peak cut algorithm are combined to perform speed regulation. Algorithm dynamic speed regulation enables the overrunning trajectory points to meet constraint requirements, starting points of the searching range are continually issued to perform, and synchronous operation of searching detection, dynamic speed regulation and trajectory execution is ensured. By performing smoothing and limiting regulation on the velocity of movement and acceleration of a robot cartesian space and joint space synchronously, an original trajectory is guaranteed to move at a reasonable speed andin a constraint condition range; and time optimal of dynamic speed regulation is realized, smooth and efficient motion of the robot in a whole space is ensured, and the precision and operating efficiency of the robot are improved.
source_title: Global time optimal trajectory programing method of industrial robot dynamic speed regulation

abstract: A robotic carton unloader (100) for unloading a carton pile (106) resting on a floor (118) includes a mobile body (114) movable across the floor on more than one wheel. A conveyor system (110) mounted on the mobile body (114) conveys unloaded cartons thereon. A robotic arm assembly (102) has a manipulator head (136) attached to a front end of the upper arm assembly. The manipulator head (136) engages at least one carton at a time from a carton pile resting on a floor for movement to the conveyor system. A built-in jacking apparatus (166) is extendable from the mobile body (114) to a floor to raise the mobile body a distance sufficient to raise at least one of the more than one wheel (162) away from contacting the floor.
source_title: ROBOTIC CARTON UNLOADER WITH INTEGRAL EXTRACTION MECHANISM

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of deep reinforcement learning, and relates to a surgical robot control method and device based on deep reinforcement learning, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a current feature vector corresponding to a detection head, and enabling the detection head to be connected with the end part of an operation arm of a surgical robot; and inputting the current feature vector into a deep neural network generated based on deep reinforcement learning training, and performing feature extraction on the current feature vector through the deep neural network to obtain attitude information of the operation arm, the posture information of the operation arm is the telescopic distance of the tail end of the operation arm and the rotation direction of the operation arm of the surgical robot at the next moment; and forming a control instruction according to the attitude information of the operating arm, and issuing the control instruction to the surgical robot, so that the surgical robot adjusts the attitude of the operating arm according to the attitude information of the operating arm. Accurate motion compensation can be carried out on the surgical robot, and the surgical success rate is increased.
